title: Roles & permissions
description: Each role is a set of permissions, and each permission has a scope that decides which records it covers.
confirmDelete: Delete the role “{{name}}”? Its holders lose these permissions immediately.
searchPlaceholder: Search by role name or description

assignment.label: Assignment
assignment.hint: Automatic: given by a rule or a setup in the system. Manual: given by HR or an administrator.
assignment.ruleHint: A rule in the system keeps this role's members up to date, so it is not assigned by hand.

roles.title: Roles
roles.body: A role is a set of permissions given to whoever holds it. Here you see the roles, how each is given (by hand or automatically) and how many people hold it, and you can open a role to review its permissions. The «Kind» column tells the roles apart: manual, automatic by a rule, a job title role (held by whoever has the title), or a level head role (held by the manager of a unit).

can.create: Create a new role with its permissions and scope
can.sync: Refresh the members of the automatic roles right away

sync.done: The members of the automatic roles were refreshed ({{count}} changes).
sync.unchanged: Members are up to date, nothing changed.

derivedHint: This role’s name and members follow its job title or level, so they cannot change here; only its permissions and description can.
